WITH circuit_counts AS (
  SELECT circuitId, AVG(round) AS average_round, COUNT(*) AS race_count
  FROM races
  GROUP BY circuitId
), total_races AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count FROM races
)
SELECT circuit_counts.circuitId, circuit_counts.average_round, circuit_counts.race_count,
       CAST(circuit_counts.race_count AS REAL) / total_races.total_count AS share
FROM circuit_counts
CROSS JOIN total_races
ORDER BY share DESC
LIMIT 10;
